title: Kth Pair Gap
statement_md: Take every pair of positions $i < j$ and write down $|a_i - a_j|$. Sort the written values. Print the $k$-th smallest (1-indexed).
input_md: The first line holds $n$ and $k$. The second line holds $n$ integers.
hints: Pattern: binary search on the value, then count.
After sorting, the number of pairs with difference <= d can be counted with two pointers in O(n).

a.sort()
lo, hi = 0, a[-1] - a[0]
while lo < hi:
    mid = (lo + hi) // 2
    if count_at_most(mid) >= k: hi = mid
    else: lo = mid + 1
print(lo)
